title: Quetta Campus, Quetta | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Quetta Campus, located in Quetta, Pakistan. Address: Directorate General, Social Welfare Department, Brewery Rd, Quetta. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=30.1913674,66.8745782. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Quetta as the city.
